name: LD-4830-DGH-01
summary: A robot joint servo-drive board with CAN FD communication. It accepts a 36–60 V supply and specifies 100 A maximum phase current, with overcurrent, undervoltage and overvoltage protection thresholds.

description.en: A robot joint servo-drive board with CAN FD communication. It accepts a 36–60 V supply and specifies 100 A maximum phase current, with overcurrent, undervoltage and overvoltage protection thresholds.
